title: Funny Toon Ever — Chili Rocket Hybrid

clips.prompt: One permanent white mischievous cartoon mascot picks up a tiny red pepper. Smooth shoulders, one pupil per eye. No clone characters.
The mascot bites the pepper, then abruptly freezes with bulging eyes and red face, natural connected arms.
Original single round white black-outline funny mascot with a huge startled face fires a vivid cartoon rocket flame; fast dramatic motion, clear hand and leg silhouettes, no extra limbs, no text.
The original mascot exhales smoky curls, wobbles, recovers the sly grin; readable 2D pose-driven motion.
